    {"i": 4, "speaker": "bot", "text": "बस कुछ details confirm कर दीजिए।"},
    {"i": 5, "speaker": "bot", "text": "आपको कितने pack या piece चाहिए होंगे?"},

    {"i": 9, "speaker": "bot", "text": "समझ गई।"},

    {"i": 11, "speaker": "bot", "text": "8 pads, 4 pads या कुछ और?"},
    {"i": 12, "speaker": "caller", "text": "piece करे।"},
    {"i": 13, "speaker": "bot", "text": "ठीक है।"},
    {"i": 14, "speaker": "bot", "text": "type of requirement में क्या चाहिए monthly sample only या कुछ और?"},
    {"i": 15, "speaker": "caller", "text": "sample only."},
    {"i": 16, "speaker": "bot", "text": "ठीक है।"},
    {"i": 17, "speaker": "bot", "text": "आप अपनी city और state भी बता दीजिए please।"}
